svg.title: velocitty — bytes from the PTY to pixels
svg.desc: The shell writes x, ESC [ 3 1 m, y and é to the PTY in two reads. The bytes land one per slot in a ring; a scanner cuts them into runs and holds the unfinished CSI until the second read; the VT sets a red pen, interns it in the style map as id 1 and writes cells; the renderer repaints the dirty row, misses the glyph LRU for é, packs it into the atlas and blits into a CPU framebuffer that is presented as one damaged strip. A second trace streams an OSC title around the ring through the stream buffer to the window title.

svg.text: velocitty — bytes from the PTY to pixels
Walkthrough derived from velocitty 2d5a1a4 source and its ring tests. Not a recording.

g.text: 1/24 read A: readSource copies 4 bytes from the PTY into the ring at head
2/24 scan cuts text x; ESC[3 has no final byte yet, so 3 bytes are held and tail stops at 1
3/24 this drain's run list: one text run whose 1-byte prefix is printable ASCII
4/24 drain() hands the runs to VtState through its Sink
5/24 printPlain writes x with the default pen, style 0 (frame 1 paints it)
6/24 read B: 5 more bytes arrive; head reaches offset 9
7/24 scan restarts at tail: the CSI is whole and parsed once, then text yé; tail = head
8/24 the reused run list now holds csi 31m and text yé
9/24 a CSI ending in m goes straight to csi.sgr: SGR 31 sets the pen to palette 1
10/24 intern misses the memo and the map: the pen is appended and mapped to id 1
11/24 text yé arrives; each cell this pen writes carries style id 1
12/24 printPlain writes y; printUtf8 decodes c3 a9 to U+00E9; row 0 is marked dirty
13/24 frame 2: renderSel repaints only rows whose dirty bit is set, background first
14/24 x and y come from the warmed ASCII table; é misses the glyph LRU's map
15/24 put() takes a free node, links it at the head (MRU) and maps é to it
16/24 rasterizeAt draws é and the atlas packs it on a shelf
17/24 blitGlyph mixes coverage: x in #aaaaaa, y and é in #aa0000; dirty bits clear
18/24 Presenter copies only the damaged pixel rows, then presentRect shows them
19/24 title · read C: an OSC 0 title with no terminator yet lands at offset 9
20/24 title · scan finds no BEL or ST: openStream copies 8 bytes out and the ring is empty
21/24 title · read D goes straight to the stream buffer; BEL ends it, END returns to the ring
22/24 title · finishStream emits the OSC as a stream run, ahead of the ring's END
23/24 title · Osc.dispatch sets the title; END then prints red after é and dirties row 0
24/24 title · drainHost passes the new title to the window once per loop
gap: not traced: keys to PTY, kitty/sixel images, selection, scrollback reflow, fonts, config
gap: not traced: pressure-mode skipping, VT replies; Peak C internals are vendored
gap: inputs from circbuffer.zig tests (1080, 655) split into reads; ids assume a fresh VT
